questions.questionText: In the story of Reiaan and Shalini, what method did Shalini use to help Reiaan feel the directions in his new room?

options.optionText: Using a rectangular grid with fixed pins and threads

questions.explanationAnswer: The text explicitly states that Shalini used a rectangular grid with fixed pins and threads to help Reiaan feel the directions.
questions.explanationQuestion: The question asks about the specific practical method used by the character Shalini to assist her brother Reiaan.
questions.correctAnswer: Using a rectangular grid with fixed pins and threads

questions.questionText: Shalini decided to use what she had learnt in Coordinate Geometry to guide Reiaan.
questions.explanationAnswer: The text states: 'Shalini has just completed Grade 9 and this time, she decided to put to use what she has learnt in Coordinate Geometry in Mathematics to guide Reiaan.'
questions.explanationQuestion: The question tests the reader's understanding of the character's motivation and application of knowledge.

questions.questionText: Shalini used a scale of ______ cm : ______ foot to mark the points in the room sketch.
questions.explanationAnswer: Page 3 states: 'Shalini was using a scale of 1 cm : 1 foot.'
questions.explanationQuestion: The question asks for the specific scale factor used in the room layout sketch.

questions.questionText: Which of the following physical items were used by Shalini to represent the room layout for Reiaan?
questions.explanationAnswer: The text mentions: 'Points in the sketch were marked using pins... objects were connected with thick wool so that Reiaan could feel their positions with his fingers.'
questions.explanationQuestion: The question identifies the materials used to create the tactile coordinate model.
